items.docs: Returns basic account information for your authorized Main Dwolla Account, including account ID, name, and links to related resources such as funding sources, transfers, and customers.

info.name: Create a funding source for an account

items.docs:
Create a funding source by adding a bank account to a Main Dwolla Account. This endpoint allows you to connect a checking or savings account using either manual bank account details or an exchange resource.

For more information about funding sources, see the [Funding Sources API Reference](https://developers.dwolla.com/docs/api-reference/funding-sources).

info.name: List funding sources for an account

params.name: removed
params.description: Filter removed funding sources. Boolean value. Defaults to `true`

items.docs: Get a list of all funding sources associated with a specific Main Dwolla Account. This endpoint returns both bank accounts and balance funding sources, with detailed information about each funding source's status, type, and available processing channels.

params.name: search
params.description: A string to search on fields `firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, `businessName`, Customer ID, and Account ID

params.name: startAmount
params.description: Only include transactions with an amount equal to or greater than `startAmount`

params.name: endAmount
params.description: Only include transactions with an amount equal to or less than `endAmount`

params.name: startDate
params.description: Only include transactions created after this date. ISO-8601 format `YYYY-MM-DD`

params.name: endDate
params.description: Only include transactions created before this date. ISO-8601 format `YYYY-MM-DD`

params.name: status
params.description: Filter on transaction status. Possible values are `pending`, `processed`, `failed`, or `cancelled`

params.name: correlationId
params.description: A string value to search on if `correlationId` was specified for a transaction

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of search results to return. Defaults to 25

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of search results to skip. Use for pagination

items.docs: Returns a paginated, searchable list of transfers associated with the specified Main Dwolla account. Supports advanced filtering by amount range, date range, transfer status, and correlation ID. Results are limited to 10,000 transfers per query; use date range filters for historical data beyond this limit.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of mass payments created by your Main Dwolla account. Results are sorted by creation date in descending order (newest first) and can be filtered by correlation ID.
